announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Corp., Fort Worth, Texas, is awarded a $93,246,155 cost-plus-fixed-fee, firm-fixed-price order (N0001927F1052) against a previously issued basic ordering agreement (N0001924G0010). This order provides avionics test equipment, test program set updates, cybersecurity upgrades, and specialized repair capabilities in support of F-35 Lightning II depot maintenance and sustainment. The effort includes Panoramic Cockpit Display Electronics Unit test sets; Communication, Navigation, and Identification Processor Test program sets; Phase Two electronic warfare subsystem operating system upgrades; Air Interceptor System Golden units; and ejection seat repair capacity expansion. The order also provides associated engineering, program management, technical data, planning, readiness reviews, and introduction-to-service support for the Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, and F-35 cooperative program partners. Work will be performed in Malabar, Florida (63%); Nashua, New Hampshire (23%); San Diego, California (7%); Guildford, United Kingdom (6%); and Cherry Point, North Carolina (1%), and is expected to be completed in January 2030. Fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Air Force) funds in the amount of $41,033,354; fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $41,033,350; and F-35 cooperative program partner funds in the amount of $11,179,451, will be obligated at the time of award. This order was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: V2X Systems LLC, Colorado Springs, Colorado, is awarded a firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity modification to a previously awarded contract (N6247020D0010). This award brings the cumulative value to $219,092,027. This modification provides for the exercise of option six for base operation support services. Work will be performed at Isa Air Base, and its outlying support sites in the Kingdom of Bahrain and is expected to be completed by November 2027. No funds will be obligated at the time of award. Fiscal 2027 operation and maintenance (Navy) funds will be obligated on individual task orders. Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Naples, Italy, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: General Dynamics Mission Systems, Manassas, Virginia, is awarded a $20,542,038 cost-plus-fixed fee modification to a previously awarded contract (N0002424C6210) to exercise an option to deliver AN/BYG-1 (Submarine Combat Control System) information assurance software builds. Work will be performed in Manassas, Virginia (80%); Middletown, Rhode Island (10%); and Chesapeake, Virginia (10%), and is expected to be completed by December 2027. Fiscal 2027 other procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $2,010,779 (51%); fiscal 2025 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) funds in the amount of $1,377,750 (35%); fiscal 2027 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $372,749 (9%); and fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $185,625 (5%), will be obligated at the time of award, of which $185,625 will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Pacific Ridge LLC,* Honolulu, Hawaii, was awarded $13,484,374 for a cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for organizational level maintenance, service call work, system and equipment familiarization and port husbandry services for 36 duty crew berthing barges and service craft. The services provided under the contract ensure safe and habitable office, berthing and messing facilities for Navy ship crews undergoing scheduled maintenance availabilities. The contract includes a one-year base period of performance and two three-month option periods pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation 52.217-9 which, if exercised, will bring the total estimated value of the contract to $20,246,974. Work under the contract will be performed in San Diego, California (33%); Puget Sound, Washington (26%); Pearl Harbor, Hawaii (18%); Yokosuka, Japan (11%); Guam (6%); and Sasebo, Japan (6%). All work is expected to be completed by May 2028 and if all options are exercised by November 2028. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, Navy funds in the amount $4,200,000 were obligated at the time of award to fund the contract’s base period of performance and the remainder will be incrementally funded with appropriate fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, Navy funds which will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. One source was solicited for this sole-source requirement pursuant to the authorities set forth in section 8(a) of the Small Business Act, direct award to an 8(a) native Hawaiian organization-owned firm. Naval Supply Systems Command Fleet Logistics Center San Diego, San Diego, California, is the contracting activity (N0024427C0001).

announcements.text: Raytheon Co., Tucson, Arizona, is awarded a $12,337,200 cost-plus-fixed-fee modification (P00036) to a previously awarded contract (N0002423C5401). This modification exercises options for design agent and engineering support to maintain the operational capabilities of the Rolling Airframe Missile weapon system, which provides anti-ship missile defense for multiple ship platforms. The effort includes design and systems engineering, software maintenance, reliability, maintainability, quality assurance, and logistics engineering support to address technical issues and sustain weapon system capabilities. Work will be performed in Tucson, Arizona, and is expected to be completed in September 2028. Federal Republic of Germany funds in the amount of $12,337,200 will be obligated at the time of award. The contract being modified was not competitively procured. Portfolio Acquisition Executive Munitions, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Fairwater Commercial Management LLC, Dania Beach, Florida, is awarded an $11,650,000 firm-fixed-price contract with pass-through elements (N3220527C1209) for a 60-day tanker time charter of one, U.S. flag, Jones Act compliant, double-hull MR tanker with an inert gas system or equivalent system and segregated ballast tanks capable of carrying a minimum of 260,000 bbls of clean product (JP5/F76/JAA) within the vessel’s natural segregation in designated cargo tanks. Work will be performed within the U.S. west coast beginning Dec. 15, 2026, and is expected to be completed by Feb. 16, 2027. Working capital funds (Transportation) in the amount of $11,650,000 are obligated for Fiscal 2027 and will expire at the end of the fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured with proposals solicited via the Government Point of Entry website and one proposal was received. Military Sealift Command, Norfolk, Virginia, is the contracting activity (N3220527C1209).

announcements.text: Northstar Marine Inc., Cape May Court House, New Jersey, was awarded a $10,364,778 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for emergency removal and disposal of objects within the Delaware River channel of the Trenton to Sea Deep Draft Navigation Project, the Schuylkill River Navigation Project, and the Chesapeake and Delaware Canal and its approaches. Bids were solicited via the internet with three received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Nov. 16, 2031. U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, is the contracting activity (W912BU-27-D-A005).
